invariants.rule: Canonical ownership from data/project-registry.json must be resolved before creating a competing implementation.
Integration checks must correspond to the exact candidate head commit.
Production-impacting releases must be traceable to a known source commit/candidate.
Merge or deployment success alone is not live visitor-facing verification.
Core numeric game state must remain finite and valid; NaN/Infinity are never valid gameplay state.
A published browser game must have a resolving production route and load without critical runtime errors.
Published code/content may not reference missing required assets.
Published content identifiers and canonical slugs must be unique within their registry scope.
Prerequisite, assessment, certification and media references must resolve to valid targets.
Production internal navigation must not target missing routes.
Security controls may not be weakened solely to make verification pass.
An R2+ recurring issue requires a durable automated regression guard unless a documented technical reason prevents one.
